definition: A name or title used for a person or thing.
book: Gulliver's Travels into Several Remote Nations of the World
author: Jonathan Swift
quote: I said, “I had not;” and desired he would explain to me “what he meant by such an appellation, applied to a mortal creature.”
example_sentence: The town earned the appellation 'the wettest place in Wales'.
